selection_policy: Every paper-2 joint_v2 event with a drafted public-source proof (36 exact Zenodo files, 2 equivalent Zenodo posterior groups; gw-event-likelihood-fits commit 6b9e3f4d, tag drafts/jointv2-public-proofs-20261109), released with the exact base8 bytes the paper-2 population analysis uses. Declared checks and replication splits are recorded per event, not selected on. Not a complete event catalog.
